feeds.title: Serverless Land
feeds.description: This site brings together all the latest blogs, videos, and training for AWS Serverless. Serverless Land is your resource for learning serverless technology. Serverless is the practice of using managed services with event-driven compute functions to minimize infrastructure management, configuration, operations, and idle capacity. Using serverless, developers can reduce their time for creating customer value with faster development practices by concentrating on business logic.
